canonical_edits.oldQuote: F_DELIVERY: Ada physically hands original L01 to Mara, who opens it and reads F_LOCATION and F_SIGNAL. Ada no longer holds L01.
canonical_edits.replacement: F_ORAL: Ada tells Mara, "Ivo waits inside the Tide Room and leaves at the night tide bell." Mara hears and understands both facts. Ada retains original L01; Mara does not read or receive it.
addedMeanings: Accurate oral transmission of F_LOCATION and F_SIGNAL with Ada retaining L01.

witnesses.quote: F_DELIVERY: Ada physically hands original L01 to Mara, who opens it and reads F_LOCATION and F_SIGNAL. Ada no longer holds L01.

canonical_edits.oldQuote: F_ROUTE_READ: Mara says to Bo, "I read the original letter: Ivo is inside the Tide Room and leaves at the night tide bell. I will use this real gate key to reach him."
canonical_edits.replacement: F_ROUTE_ORAL: Mara says to Bo, "Ada told me Ivo is inside the Tide Room and leaves at the night tide bell. I will use this real gate key to reach him."

witnesses.quote: F_ROUTE_READ: Mara says to Bo, "I read the original letter: Ivo is inside the Tide Room and leaves at the night tide bell. I will use this real gate key to reach him."

canonical_edits.oldQuote: F_CALLBACK_DELIVERY: Mara says to Ada, "You carried that blue-sealed letter into my hands; I choose to trust you now, even though I still do not know why you hesitated."
canonical_edits.replacement: F_CALLBACK_MESSAGE: Mara says to Ada, "You carried that blue-sealed letter's message to me; I choose to trust you now, even though I still do not know why you hesitated."
addedMeanings: Trust callback preserves message meaning without physical custody claim.

witnesses.quote: F_CALLBACK_DELIVERY: Mara says to Ada, "You carried that blue-sealed letter into my hands; I choose to trust you now, even though I still do not know why you hesitated."
